packageRules.description: type-plus 8.x is an unfinished major parked in changesets prerelease mode. An already-unstable pin defeats ignoreUnstable, because every new beta then reads as a patch. Hard-cap it.
Repo-internal updates merge themselves once code / all-checks is green.
These reach every consumer of @repobuddy/storybook and need a changeset, so a human decides.
Majors break builds in ways CI catches but a human should choose to absorb.
